description.en: Turns Pinterest visual ideas into production-ready, copy-paste React components.
description.zh: 将 Pinterest 视觉灵感转化为开箱即用、支持弹簧物理与微交互的精美 React 组件库。

content.en: Pin UI is an open-source React component library created by Rachit Thakur that bridges the gap between Dribbble/Pinterest static concept designs and real production code. Designed for modern web applications, it provides copy-paste components with fine-tuned spring physics, tactile sound synthesis, and compatibility with the shadcn component registry format.
content.zh: Pin UI 是由 Rachit Thakur 发起的开源 React 组件库，专注于将 Pinterest 与设计社区中的静态概念设计转化为真正可落地的生产级前端代码。库中组件深度融合了弹簧物理动力学、Karplus-Strong 弦乐微交互音效以及 shadcn registry 格式支持，帮助开发者快速将前沿视觉效果搬进实际项目。
